bible_verses.telugu: మీలో ఏ మనుష్యునికైనను నూరు గొఱ్ఱలు కలిగి యుండగా వాటిలో ఒకటి తప్పిపోయినయెడల అతడు తొంబది తొమి్మదింటిని అడవిలో విడిచిపెట్టి, తప్పిపోయి నది దొరకువరకు దానిని వెదక వెళ్లడా?
bible_verses.english: Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them. Doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost sheep until he finds it?

bible_verses.telugu: నా అంతరింద్రియములను నీవే కలుగజేసితివి నా తల్లి గర్భమందు నన్ను నిర్మించినవాడవు నీవే.
bible_verses.english: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother’s womb.

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే దేవుడు మనయెడల తన ప్రేమను వెల్లడిపరచుచున్నాడు; ఎట్లనగా మనమింకను పాపులమై యుండగానే క్రీస్తు మనకొరకు చనిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

devotional.prayer_english: Father, thank You for loving me before I even knew how to call upon Your name. When I was lost and far from You, Your relentless grace chased me down and brought me back into Your arms. I admit I cannot earn this overwhelming love, but today I simply open my heart to receive it. Teach me to rest securely in Your goodness and to live each day in response to Your boundless grace. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Father, thank You for loving me before I even knew how to call upon Your name. devotional.reflection_english: Long before you drew your first breath, God loved you with an extravagant, relentless passion. He does not wait for us to prove our worth or earn His affection; instead, He actively pursues us even in our darkest, most distant moments. As you sing, let your heart rest in the overwhelming truth that Christ gave everything to bring you home. You are deeply known, fiercely fought for, and endlessly loved.
